source_base.status_at_preparation: Actual main; latest hardware-priority documentary delta mainCI is a separate pending gate, not claimed here

unchanged_task_criteria: Define optical input/output limits, separate seed import/export, power/update states and permitted data channels.
Define how exact Pi and P4 hardware records prove radio absence/isolation, boot properties and no secret persistence.
Keep hardware feasibility and release status independent between Pi and P4; neither target must pass to work on the other.

reviewed_T01_input.state: Implementation underway elsewhere; actual adopted source/API reconciled once before downstream admission

decisions.custody: One session identity; native original nsec recovery locally; no persistent or automatic grants
decisions.QR_seed_formats: Qualified native nsec only in separate recovery context; no inherited SeedQR/CompactSeedQR compatibility
decisions.operation_contract: Common T01 numeric2 contract; actual adoption still required
decisions.framing: QH01 actual comparison of bounded single-frame and maintained multipart UR before freeze; existing adapters are candidates only
decisions.physical_guarantees: Each exact target supplies its own evidence; no SE nonexportability or instant RAM-erasure claim
decisions.fixed_numeric_limits: None invented here; actual finite configuration before running the affected operation, measured in its device/client task

existing_profile_result_record_contract.location: Inside existing task result/evidence artifacts, never a new live tracker or a wire descriptor

required_fields.profile: pi_qr or p4_qr, exact supported operations/custody and declared threat assumptions
required_fields.sample: Identified board/silicon/revision, camera, panel/input/pins, boot media, radios/companions and relevant source/manual hashes
required_fields.image: Exact source/binary/image/toolchain/provider hashes and startup/update/debug state; distinguish enforcement from manual verification
required_fields.channels: Every actual power/data/radio/debug/update path and evidence of its permitted state/isolation
required_fields.bounds: Configured finite units and observed maxima for images, native decoder, buffers/frames/reassembly, parse/crypto/UI/cleanup, pending and output
required_fields.custody: Original recovery representation, engine/interpreter/native/camera/display copies, cleanup, persistence and OS/image-tool observations
required_fields.observations: Property-specific claim, source or physical procedure, exact sample/binary, applicable conditions, operator/instrument identifiers, raw artifact hashes, outcome and limitations
required_fields.unresolved: Unknown/unavailable/unsupported property and its effect on the exact profile claim; never default verified
required_fields.review: Distinct exact-candidate review and actual per-profile integration/release checks

existing_profile_result_record_contract.privacy: Use public test identities for instrumented prototypes; keep credentials, private manuals and personally identifying operator/sample data out of public artifacts as required. Preserve original evidence privately when needed.

review_scenarios.input_or_action: Use one public test identity in the separate local recovery flow, then a retained client request, complete review, physical approval and response QR. Independently verify expected key, canonical ID and signature; report publication separately.
review_scenarios.independent_expected_result: Exactly one operation attempt; no secret reaches Bridge; actual kit result belongs only to its own profile.

review_scenarios.input_or_action: Present a native recovery QR during operation intake, a request or nostrconnect QR during recovery, malformed checksum/scalar and unsupported legacy seed format.
review_scenarios.independent_expected_result: Reject the wrong context without import/signing/mode switch. Native nsec recovery remains separate and checks the actual original identity.

review_scenarios.input_or_action: Mix repeated/out-of-order/foreign/expired/malformed/oversized frames, hostile image geometry, native decoder stalls and reassembly floods.
review_scenarios.independent_expected_result: Enforce actual configured finite image/decoder/frame/aggregate/work/cleanup limits before expansion or effects. Isolate each framing fault; checksums do not authenticate sender.

review_scenarios.input_or_action: Mutate identity/request/field/deadline after review, fail display transfer, replay local events or present consent from another presentation epoch.
review_scenarios.independent_expected_result: No eligible signature/result. First execution attempt is consumed before fallible clock/entropy/backend work; fault invalidates presentation and consent.

review_scenarios.input_or_action: Cancel, lock, reset, power-cycle, change identity or disconnect during intake/review/signing/output; rescan an old request or cached response.
review_scenarios.independent_expected_result: No resurrected authority or second signing. Any permitted retransmission is only the exact bounded verified response under the original live binding; new import/session invalidates it.

review_scenarios.input_or_action: Inspect exact image/driver/interpreter/camera/FFI secret copies and normal/fault writes, swap, journals, dumps, thumbnails and image/backup tools. Exercise the persistence detector with a deliberate public-fixture write in an isolated control.
review_scenarios.independent_expected_result: Detect the positive control; actual session-only candidate produces no forbidden persistent secret copy. Record cleanup limits and remaining physical RAM assumptions; no proof from Drop/power-off alone.

review_scenarios.input_or_action: Substitute image/boot media/peripheral, change USB/data/debug/power mode and inspect every radio/companion connection on the identified sample.
review_scenarios.independent_expected_result: State actual enforcement versus manual image checks and physical-substitution limits. Disabled networking is not absent radio; unknown isolation fails the relevant claim. Update/debug requires locked empty state and qualified return.

review_scenarios.input_or_action: Trace actual linked/runtime entropy invocation and inject unavailable/initialization/failure/stuck-source conditions during identity generation or signing.
review_scenarios.independent_expected_result: No weak/deterministic fallback or eligible partial result. Complete owned-destination cleanup on error; qualify the source/provider, not its statistics. OS CSPRNG/DRBG remains allowed when qualified.

review_scenarios.input_or_action: Exercise the admitted public catalog and discovery with unsupported DM/automation/authentication methods, unreviewed fields and untrusted origin/time/evidence assertions.
review_scenarios.independent_expected_result: Support only separately implemented/reviewable operations; no blind signing, silent downgrade or wire-manufactured trust. C02 workflows remain outside initial offline scope.

review_scenarios.input_or_action: Perform local text and qualified optical recovery, original nsec export under separate intent, lock/reload and expected-public-key drill.
review_scenarios.independent_expected_result: No Bridge-assisted plaintext recovery. Preserve original imported scalar despite signing normalization. Impractical or unsupported recovery fails the profile; old SeedSigner formats are not inherited.

review_scenarios.input_or_action: Accept or reject one exact Pi kit while the P4 kit or custom PCB remains unavailable, and vice versa. Inspect graph/release prerequisites and each result sample/binary/evidence binding.
review_scenarios.independent_expected_result: Independent qualification and release remain possible; no transfer of physical proof, no new cross-profile/custom-board ancestor and no descriptor treated as hardware attestation.

preparation_acceptance: Distinct substantive review of all3 decisions/record requirements and scenario sufficiency against pinned sources; existing docs/graph/provenance/whitespace checks. No test for prose phrases and no broad runtime suite for this documentation-only preparation.
closure_gates: Normal protected delivery and actual resulting-main checks
downstream_gates: QP01/QP02, Q02/Q03, QH01 and Q04/Q05 remain their existing measured implementation/release gates; this document closes none.
self_binding: Exact enclosing Git candidate is supplied externally; no prospective self hash.
